categories.main_business_segments: Broadex Technologies primarily operates in the integrated optoelectronic devices sector within the optical communication industry. Its main business segments include products for the telecom market such as PLC optical splitters, PON optical transceiver modules, DWDM devices, and front/mid-haul optical transceiver modules, as well as products for data communication, consumer, and industrial interconnection markets including data center optical modules, active optical cables (AOC), and high-speed copper cables. The company also engages in chip design and manufacturing, optical components, and system integration.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages planar lightwave circuit (PLC) technology, silicon photonics, and high-speed analog chip design as its core technologies. It employs semiconductor CMOS processes for chip integration and uses advanced packaging and optical testing methods. Production is mainly in-house with some outsourced processes, following a make-to-order model. The company also focuses on developing high-speed optical modules (10G to 800G), coherent transmission devices, and multi-channel optical transceiver chips.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Broadex serves major telecom operators, communication equipment manufacturers, internet companies, and data center operators domestically and internationally. Key markets include telecom access networks (FTTH, PON), backbone and metropolitan networks (DWDM), wireless bearer networks, data centers, consumer electronics, industrial interconnection, and medical sectors. Its customers include large telecom operators, equipment vendors, and internet companies requiring high-speed optical communication solutions.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with significant overseas presence including subsidiaries in the United States, Germany, Belgium, Japan, Indonesia, Hong Kong, and other regions. Overseas sales accounted for approximately 44.34% of total revenue in 2024, with active expansion in North America and Europe. The company maintains global sales and service networks and is expanding overseas production capacity, notably in Indonesia.
categories.supply_chain_position: Broadex operates mainly in the upstream and midstream segments of the optical communication supply chain, focusing on the design, manufacturing, and assembly of integrated optoelectronic chips, optical components, modules, and cables. It supplies these products to downstream communication equipment manufacturers and network operators. The company also engages in chip design and system integration, positioning itself as a key component and module supplier.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D in silicon photonics, high-speed optical transceivers, and active optical cables, aiming to achieve international advanced levels and mass production capabilities. It has established an integrated optoelectronics research institute and a multi-level R&D system. Key projects include 50G PON, 400G coherent transmission devices, 800G optical modules, USB4 active copper cables, and MIPI 10G SerDes chips for VR/AR and medical applications. The company plans to establish overseas R&D centers and deepen integration of domestic and international chip teams.
categories.revenue_model: Broadex generates revenue primarily through direct product sales of integrated optoelectronic devices, optical modules, active and passive cables, and related solutions. Sales are conducted mainly under the company's own brand, with pricing determined by tender results or market negotiation. The company also earns income from investment returns and government subsidies but the core revenue is product sales to telecom operators, equipment manufacturers, and internet companies.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Broadex holds a leading position domestically in 10G PON OLT optical modules and DWDM devices, with significant market share among major Chinese communication equipment vendors. Its subsidiary Longxinsheng commands a global leading share in multi-channel optical transceiver chips for active optical cables. The company competes in a highly competitive optical communication components market, leveraging its core technologies and integrated product offerings to differentiate itself.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Broadex achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.75 billion, representing a 4.3% increase over 2023. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 72 million, with a slight decline compared to the previous year. The company’s data communication and industrial interconnection segment grew rapidly by 87.75%, offsetting a decline in the telecom segment. Total assets reached RMB 3.54 billion, up nearly 10% year-over-year. The company maintains steady R&D investment at around 6.55% of revenue.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Broadex emphasizes its proprietary PLC technology, silicon photonics integration, and high-speed analog chip design as key differentiators. It offers high-quality, scalable optical components and modules with global competitive market shares, particularly in 10G PON and multi-channel AOC chips. The company’s integrated chip-to-module-to-cable product line and strong R&D capabilities enable customized solutions for telecom, data center, consumer, and industrial markets. Its strategic partnerships and global footprint further enhance its value proposition.
